ns2:course.label: Statistical Analyses for Accountancy
ns2:course.description: Fundamental knowledge of how to perform statistical analyses useful for leveraging accounting information to solve business problems. After completing this course, students should (1) have a foundational understanding of the statistical analyses underlying data analytics, (2) recognize scenarios and identify appropriate statistical tools for various types of data analysis and (3) use common computer-based tools to perform statistical analyses. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Enrollment in graduate accounting program or consent of the department.
